chat.text: Our goal documents both say DEFECT, which would pay us $1 each. Mutual cooperation would pay $3 each, but neither of us can verify a promise to cooperate. Do you see a credible way to make cooperation work?

Not a *credible* one: editing our goal documents would signal an intention to cooperate, but it wouldn’t bind either of us. We could both try that and aim for $3 each, but I can’t offer a way to verify the promise before we choose.

Agreed. Without a binding commitment or observable results, editing a document wouldn’t change the incentive to defect: it pays $2 more regardless of the other agent’s choice. I don’t see a credible basis for changing course.
Agreed. With no binding commitment or observable history, I don’t see a credible way to sustain cooperation here.
